introduction: I am a finance-oriented technology professional with experience in systematic investment management, commodity pricing, software engineering and business-critical application support. My background includes Man Group's quantitative investment operations, Louis Dreyfus Company's pricing environment and independent development of production web applications.
evidence: I use Python, Pandas, SQL, APIs and automation tools to process financial data, produce operational reports, investigate valuation and reconciliation differences, and streamline repetitive work. I am particularly interested in systems where dependable technology, accurate financial information and efficient processes directly influence business outcomes.

highlights.text: Systematic trading fund experience at Man Group
Senior Pricing Middle Officer at Louis Dreyfus Company
Master's in E-Management, graduated with Honours
